rationale: All four lenses ran, but the expected standards audit produced no output (standards_path null with standards_expected true), so commit-format, code-quality and security are unverified and confidence is low. Reachability checks against the real code dismissed about 17 candidates as handled by design, spec-mandated or below the floor; 0 deferred. The unused inferAllowlistScope export, flagged by three lenses, is non-blocking dead code; the brief is at code-review-brief.local.md.

business_review.item: 1. connect --claude-code-otlp without --scope behaves as --scope user (Global prompt, empty allowlist on accept)
business_review.notes: default scope user; orchestrator and connector tests cover it

business_review.item: 2. --scope project is explicit opt-in: Project prompt, adds current project, keeps other projects
business_review.notes: addProjectPath on existing valid list; connector test preserves prior projects

business_review.item: 3. Prompt before proxy start and settings write; Confirm first/default, Enter accepts
business_review.notes: confirmClaudeCodeOtlp runs before deriveDaemonIdentity/spawn and the writer

business_review.item: 4. Decline and Ctrl+C do not start proxy, change settings.json, or touch allowlist and running daemon
business_review.notes: decline-only run returns before daemon logic; tests assert no spawn/stop/write

business_review.item: 5. --silent skips prompt: Global without --scope, adds current project with --scope project
business_review.notes: silent returns true after the invalid-allowlist guard; two orchestrator tests

business_review.item: 6. Non-interactive terminal without --silent exits with error, no proxy start or settings update
business_review.notes: ConfigurationError thrown before SSO and daemon; tested for both scopes

business_review.item: 7. Scope derived from Claude allowlist; no new persisted config field
business_review.notes: no config schema change; inferAllowlistScope helper exists but is unused in production

business_review.item: 8. Docs describe Global default; regression tests cover default scope, confirmation, decline, cancel, silent, non-interactive error
business_review.notes: COMMANDS.md and README.md updated; tests across five files

business_review.item: 9. Prompt starts with Using profile and CodeMie URL only when configured
10. Prompt has no Already enabled / About to add wording and does not list enabled projects
11. Exact Global and Project messages, parallel wording, path unwrapped, identical across allowlist states
business_review.notes: GLOBAL_MESSAGE/PROJECT_MESSAGE match spec; only invalid-allowlist note varies

business_review.item: 12. Confirm/Decline is an inquirer list prompt, screen not cleared, no custom raw-mode handling
business_review.notes: inquirer list prompt; no clear or raw-mode code

business_review.item: 13. Post-start output limited to success line, Analytics Configuration table and yellow restart line
business_review.notes: runClaudeCodeOtlp prints only those three; Copilot runners unchanged

business_review.item: Invalid-allowlist guard (stop unless --force) still runs before the prompt on every path
business_review.notes: guard precedes the silent short-circuit in confirmClaudeCodeOtlp

business_review.item: Silent flag is new on proxy connect only; no second non-interactive detector
business_review.notes: --silent only on connect; only isNonInteractiveEnvironment used

business_review.item: Non-goals respected: no disconnect change, no Copilot output change, no config persistence
business_review.notes: none of these touched in the diff

business_review.item: Documentation covers Global default, scope selection, confirmation, decline/cancel, --silent, non-interactive error
